text: APPROVE: The three `continue` guards became `IsFirstPartySource(file, root) && --count == 0`, which keeps the original check order and decrements `count` only for files that pass all the filters, so behaviour is unchanged; moving the three `if`s and the `||` chain out of the nested loop clearly drops the complexity below 15, and the new private static helper uses only existing members, so it should not introduce warnings. I reviewed only the diff, not the full file, and did not build it.
